title: Knowledge Base Files
description: Upload and manage documents for your voice agents to reference.
yourDocumentsDescription: Documents shared across all agents in your organization
uploadDialogDescription: Upload a PDF or document file to add to your knowledge base
chunkedSaveHint: Saving re-splits and re-embeds this document. Agents keep using the current version until that finishes.
fullDocumentSaveHint: Agents keep using the current version until the saved text finishes processing, usually a few seconds.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{filename}"?
agentsUsingPrevious: Agents keep using the previous version until the update finishes.
agentsStillUsingPrevious: Agents are still using the previous version.
unsupportedFileType: Please select a supported file type: {types}
fileTooLarge: File size must be less than 5MB
storageUploadError: Failed to upload file to storage
retrievalModeQuestion: How should the agent use this document?
fullDocumentDescription: The entire document is provided to the agent on each retrieval. Best for menus, price lists, FAQs, and other small reference documents.
chunkedSearchDescription: The document is split into chunks and the most relevant ones are retrieved. Better for large documents like manuals or policies.
externalProcessingBody: Documents are sent to Dograh's managed Model Proxy Service for parsing and chunking when they are uploaded or edited. Dograh Model Proxy Service does not store or read your documents - the extracted text and embeddings are returned and stored locally in your self-hosted database.
